7879.title: Plugin command transport bypasses configured proxies
7879.rootCauseOneLine: Plugin command POSTs override global fetch routing with a plain undici Agent, bypassing proxy environment settings.
7879.proposedFix: Use the existing EnvHttpProxyAgent with the same extended headers timeout and real-network proxy/bypass regression coverage.
7879.caveats: Repeated by the same agent on Linux; original macOS sandbox and HTTPS TLS transport not directly tested.
